objective: Consume accepted immutable domain financial facts and post deterministic balanced journals into Accounting Core without taking source-domain ownership.

blocked: PAY.1-3.ACCEL accepted payment runtime implementing its accepted fact contract
ACC.AP.1 accepted AP/vendor runtime implementing its accepted fact contract
accepted tax jurisdiction and control-mapping facts
Finance-approved versioned posting-rule and account-mapping package

repository.name: ACP-Enterprise
repository.start_rule: Only after all blocked dependencies are authoritative: fetch origin and create a unique isolated worktree from current origin/customer-management-v1; record the full SHA and single Alembic head.

shared_path_limits.backend/app/accounting/contracts.py: add only accepted automated-posting, rule, outcome, and reconciliation contracts
shared_path_limits.backend/app/accounting/repository.py: add only Company-scoped posting-rule, claim, outcome, and failure-queue operations
shared_path_limits.backend/app/accounting/service.py: consume existing Core journal APIs without weakening balance, period, control, idempotency, audit, or immutability invariants
shared_path_limits.backend/app/events/types.py: add only posting events named by accepted producer contracts and Accounting outcome events
shared_path_limits.backend/app/platform/permissions/**: add only contract-approved Accounting posting/reconciliation permissions; no default grants
shared_path_limits.source-domain contracts/services: add only accepted fact/receipt seams; no source lifecycle or financial-semantic changes

prohibited_paths: backend/app/accounting/models.py except separately approved slot-5 persistence
backend/app/inventory/** except consumption of an accepted public fact contract
backend/app/payroll/** except consumption of an accepted public fact contract

accepted_source_facts.tax: invoice tax total accepted; jurisdiction and control mapping required

required_invariants: exactly one effective approved rule and mapping per eligible event
every posted journal has at least two non-zero lines and debits equal credits
source identity and canonical digest replay is idempotent; contradictory replay posts nothing
posted journals and lines are immutable; corrections use linked reversal/corrective journals
closed and closing periods fail closed without implicit date shifting
Company and Branch isolation applies to event, rule, mapping, journal, queue, receipt, and audit evidence
journal, lines, posting source, audit, outbox, and durable outcome commit atomically
every eligible source event has exactly one explainable posting/nonposting/failure state
missing or unknown source facts, mappings, amounts, and identities are never treated as zero

migration.required: only if accepted posting-rule/outcome/queue persistence is not already owned by Core
migration.parent_rule: descend from the then-current single authoritative head after ACC.AP.1 and preceding slots integrate
migration.mechanical_reparenting: allowed before publication only when DDL, data, runtime, and downgrade semantics are unchanged and full validation passes

validation: event schema/version and canonical digest contract tests for every accepted producer
posting-rule effective-date, overlap, unknown-version, and mapping tests
balanced-entry, exact decimal, rounding, control-account, and trial-balance tests
idempotent replay, contradictory replay, and concurrent duplicate tests
atomic rollback, no orphan, no partial journal, and crash-before/after-commit tests
failure queue lease, retry, expiry, disposition, and reconciliation tests
posting-receipt delivery retry and source-domain status consistency tests
Company/Branch isolation and authorization/SOD negative tests
sensitive-data exclusion from payloads, logs, failures, audit, and receipts
AR/AP/tax/inventory/payroll source-to-control reconciliation for accepted producers
Ruff, MyPy, focused and affected backend regressions
if a revision exists: fresh upgrade, downgrade/re-upgrade, drift, and exactly one Alembic head
Markdown/JSON/link checks, git diff --check, and focused secret/private-key scan

environment_gates.cutover: separate owner and independent Finance approval required

stop_conditions: genuine accounting or Finance mapping decision
Preview, Production, import, cutover, or irreversible operation
completion: all producer contracts and posting-rule mappings are authoritative
all focused and affected validation passes
migration integrates in slot 5 or is evidenced unnecessary
one exact-boundary commit is normally pushed and local/remote are synchronized
